SPEC-11 correctness (gate fix-2: lint, typecheck, test+coverage pass)

rubric.result: n/a — CI/doc publish happens after review

findings.issue: The stake select does not inherit the app font. Form controls don't inherit font-family by default, so the option text renders in the UA control font, not system-ui like the rest of the screen. `.screen button` already sets `font-family: inherit` for buttons (line 41).
findings.evidence: .config-fields select { appearance: none; min-height: 44px; ... font-size: 15px; } has no font-family; :root sets font-family: system-ui, sans-serif.
findings.fix: Add `font-family: inherit;` to `.config-fields select` (optionally `cursor: pointer;` to match `.screen button`).

findings.issue: The select border #4a515c against the #1a1d22 panel/select background is about 2.0:1, below the WCAG 1.4.11 3:1 non-text contrast guide for a control boundary. The colours come from the storyboard and axe doesn't check this. The control stays identifiable because its text and the #f2f3f5 chevron are high contrast, so this is not a failure.
findings.evidence: border: 1px solid #4a515c on background #1a1d22 (panel background #1a1d22, styles.css:111).
findings.fix: Optional: lighten the border (e.g. #6b7380, about 3.3:1), or leave it as the storyboard specifies and record this in the a11y notes.

findings.issue: CASH_STAKES is built from `[2,3,4,6,10,20].map(sb => ({ smallBet: sb, bigBet: 2*sb }))` and not written as the literal list from D-3. The values are equal and SPEC-01 asserts them, but the REQ-006.1 list can't be read straight off the source.
findings.fix: Optional: write the six `{ smallBet, bigBet }` literals inside Object.freeze.

summary: All SPEC items are implemented and tested. CASH_STAKES holds exactly the six stakes in order and is frozen; the default stays the literal $4/$8. The select is id config-stake with a <label for>, option texts `$2 / $4`..`$20 / $40` and values `sb/bb` (Q-1/A-3). Buy-in is read-only text at 20 big bets of the chosen stake. Start game passes `{ ...config, stake }` (proved by e2e SPEC-08: $10/$20 header, $400 stacks, SB $5 / BB $10, same-origin only). The unit tests assert blinds, buy-ins and header for all six stakes (SPEC-02) and the full $10/$20 case (SPEC-03). The D-2 edit to the locked TASK-2.1 test changes only extraction: dt tags stripped, selected option text taken for a select dd, and the no-controls check becomes exactly ['<select ']. The expected fields/buttons are unchanged, and input/textarea are still forbidden. There is no money wording; SPEC-06/09 check the pattern for every stake, in unit tests and in the browser. Deviation (appearance:none + data-URI chevron): it is still a native <select>, so role combobox, keyboard and the native picker are unchanged. No outline:none applies, so the UA focus ring stays. Text #f2f3f5 on #1a1d22 is high contrast. The app has one dark theme (color-scheme: dark). A data: URI makes no network request, and SPEC-08's same-origin check passes. SPEC-09's 44 px check passes in WebKit and Chromium. I re-ran the 3 unit files (8 pass) and e2e stake-choice + home in Chromium and WebKit (20 pass); no server left running. No BLOCKER or MAJOR findings; two MINOR CSS polish items and one NIT.
